UI/UX consolidation U1–U10

2026-10-19 · /, /azure, /users, /settings (removed) · local Development build, desktop 1440×1000 in Chrome plus phone captures from the Playwright run. Before shots come from the same running app, taken minutes before the change.

/azure, first screen (U1, U2, U3, U4, U10)

  • U4 Lead paragraph: ~90 words restating the tiles became two sentences under 40 words: cause plus next step. The rule-based fallback follows the same rule, and a narrator:2 hash input forces regeneration.
  • U3 “What changed” moved INTO the hero as “Since the last scan”. It was a 129px half-width pane beside the 342px uptime card.
  • U2 “Needs attention” is now the second pane. It was last, at y=1106 in a 935px viewport.
  • U1 Forecast: “Spent so far $22.01” beside “Projected $7.08” became “Spent this month $4.34”. The $22 was the rolling 30-day total; $17.67 of it landed in September.
  • U10 “2 item(s)” became “2 items”, “finding(s)” became “finding”. The Rescan/Listen title tooltips (mouse-only) are one focusable ⓘ hint.

/azure, below the fold (U2, U3, U10)

  • Two-column desktop layout removed: its only half-width pair is gone, so it is one column of four panes: status, actions, spend, uptime.
  • Uptime gets the full width. Day columns are minmax(cell, 1fr), so they stretch on desktop and still scroll inside the card on a phone.
  • Row names are buttons that open each app's drawer. The title on 330 cells, the chips and the percentages is gone; that text now shows in the drawer.

/azure, per-app drawer (U9)

  • One place for one app: status and streak, its 30-day strip, the uptime sentence (bad days, deploys, exceptions), response time when it is in the slowest six, attention lines and changes naming it, and 30-day reach from /api/signins (fetched once, on the first drawer open).
  • Native <dialog> + showModal(): focus trap, Escape, inert page, backdrop light-dismiss. Not Radzen's side dialog, which renders outside the page and loses its scoped CSS and state.

/azure, Advanced diagnostics drawer (U8)

  • Was an inline .app-pane--tall section that pushed the page down; now a drawer. The ranked queue still replaces “Needs attention” in place behind it.
  • Split button became two buttons: a Radzen popup would escape the modal and be inert.
  • Filter pills fixed while here: rz-button-text is not a Radzen 10 class, so every UNselected filter rendered as a filled primary button.

/, catalogue cards (U5)

  • A red DOWN (or amber Degraded) badge on the foot line, only for a card that is not healthy. PoSeeReview was down and looked identical to every other card.
  • Hosts: .azurewebsites.net dropped, and the name gets a real ellipsis. It was clipped mid-word because text-overflow on an inline-flex parent does nothing.

/users (U6)

  • Three KPI tiles (a third of a 1280px row each, for one or two digits) became one stat line under the title, read time on the end.
  • “Reach per app” bars plus “Cost per person” bars (five times $0.00) became one table: app, people, sign-ins, and $/person only when some group actually billed something. App names link to /azure?focus=.
  • The last window picked is remembered in localStorage, replacing the deleted settings page's “default window”.

/settings deleted (U7)

  • Reachable only from Ctrl+K. Auto-refresh was saved and read by nothing; theme and sound were already palette commands; its heading icon rendered as the word “PALETTE” (not in the icon subset).
  • Compact density is now the palette command “Toggle Compact Density”. Service worker cache bumped to pops-pwa-v5, with /settings dropped from its precache list.

Phone, 390×844 (after, captured by the E2E run)

  • All 25 Playwright UI tests pass at both viewports: pane fit, axe (no serious or critical), icon glyphs, /users overflow by element bounds.
